notes.title: Martian Law - New Build Is Live! - Difficulty Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35667842/cdf2df20ddc43c46c352fe71e9b91322a3cc05ea.png

We appreciate all the feedback we have been getting from our players. We realized difficulty was an issue that needed to be addressed.

In the latest build we made a couple adjustments to help the game's difficulty. Level unlocks and achievements should be a little easier to reach now.

Martian Law will continue to be FREE on Steam (PC) until April 10th. 

Thank you for playing. Take care of each other and please stay safe.

notes.title: Martian Law - Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35667842/50a69e63ed8cd1d89e777a6c97d0b8a8f7f6d463.png

Linclo Games is excited to announce Martian Law will launch on Steam on October 18th! We have been working tirelessly to get the gameplay tight. We really think you are going to enjoy this little arcade experience.

We recently added a couple of new features:

 Steam Leaderboards
 Steam Achievements

Linclo Games is a small indie studio and we appreciate your support. Our players are our top priority and we couldn't do this without you. Please let us know if you have any questions about the game.
